ingredients: 2 tablespoons cornstarch 12 teaspoon sugar 14 teaspoon salt 5 boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes 14 cup oil 2 tablespoons minced fresh gingerroot (can use up to 1 tablespoon more if desired) 1 tablespoon minced fresh garlic 1 small onion, chopped 2 red bell peppers, chopped into 1-inch pieces 2 carrots, sliced thinly diagonally 2 cups cashews (or to taste) 12 cup ketchup 4 tablespoons soy sauce 12 teaspoon salt 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce 3 tablespoons sugar 1 12 teaspoons sesame oil 14 teaspoon cayenne pepper (can use more to taste) 12 cup chicken broth
directions: Combine all sauce ingredients; set aside. In a medium bowl, toss together the chicken with cornstarch, sugar and salt (making sure that the chicken is coated well). Heat a wok or large frypan with oil to hot (not smoking). Add in chicken, ginger, garlic and onion; stir-fry about 1 minute. Add in peppers and carrots, stir-fry about 2-3 minutes. Add in the prepared sauce, cook stirring until simmering. Add in cashews and serve immediately.

title: Finneys Sticky Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 12 ounces, weight Elbow Macaroni 8 ounces, weight Sharp Cheddar Cheese 8 ounces, weight Medium Chedddar Cheese 4 Tablespoons Butter 1/4 cups Milk Salt And Pepper, to taste
directions: Preheat oven to 400F. Cook macaroni noodles per package instructions. While noodles are cooking, shred cheeses and mix together. Cut butter into small pieces, at least 8. Once noodles are done, drain them but do not rinse. Put noodles immediately into a 9 x 13 baking dish. Add cheese, milk and butter chunks, salt and pepper to your liking. (I like it very peppery.) Stir to combine. Cover dish with foil sprayed with cooking spray and bake for 20 minutes. Now that the cheese has melted, take it out of the oven and stir to get everything combined. Bake for an additional 15-20 more minutes without the foil so the top gets crispy. Serve yourself first and enjoy. Serve with Polska kielbasa sausage and French style green beans for a really comforting dinner.

title: Super Simple Feijoa Sauce
ingredients: 4 feijoas 1 tablespoon whole grain mustard 2 tablespoons brown sugar
directions: Cut feijoas in half and scoop out the flesh, add to blender. Add remaining ingredients pulse until smooth.

title: Borscht(Russian Soup)
ingredients: 5 peeled beets 1 1/2 qt. water 1 onion, chopped 1 c. tomato puree 1 Tbsp. lemon juice 1 tsp. sugar 1/2 tsp. dill weed salt and pepper sour cream (optional)
directions: Grate beets and combine with onion and water in a heavy kettle. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer about 45 minutes. Add tomato puree, lemon juice, dill, salt and pepper. Cook 45 minutes more. Heat but do not boil. Serve hot or cold topped with sour cream (optional, omit for low cholesterol). Serves 4 to 6. Low cholesterol.

title: Mrs. G'S Casserole
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1 medium onion, sliced 3/4 c. uncooked instant rice 1 regular size can corn, undrained 2 small cans tomato sauce 1 c. water salt and pepper to taste
directions: Brown ground beef and onion; drain the fat. Add instant rice, corn, tomato sauce, water and salt and pepper to taste. Place in casserole dish. Lay strips of bacon across the top and bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Pizzeria Lola's Roasted Cauliflower with Calabrian Chile
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower, cut into 1 1/2-inch florets 1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil Salt and freshly ground black pepper 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice 2 teaspoons diced Calabrian chiles (found in Italian specialty markets) Fresh flat-leaf parsley, roughly chopped, for garnish Lemon zest, for garnish
directions: Preheat the oven to 500 degrees F. In a large mixing bowl, toss the cauliflower florets with the olive oil and some salt and pepper. Place the cauliflower in a large roasting pan (a baking sheet works, too). Place the pan in the oven and roast until the florets are lightly charred and cooked through, 15 to 20 minutes. Check on the cauliflower occasionally to ensure an even roast. Remove from the oven, place on a serving plate and toss with the lemon juice and chiles. Garnish with lemon zest and parsley. Serve immediately. This recipe was provided by a chef, restaurant or culinary professional and makes a large quantity. The Food Network Kitchens chefs have not tested this recipe, in the proportions indicated, and therefore, we cannot make any representation as to the results.

title: Heirloom Tomato Panzanella
ingredients: 3 tablespoons olive oil 1 small French bread, cut into slices kosher salt 2 heirloom tomatoes, cut in wedges 1 pint red pear tomatoes or 1 pint cherry tomatoes, halved 1 cucumber, unpeeled, seeded, and sliced 1/2-inch thick 1 red bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1-inch cubes 1 yellow bell pepper, seeded and cut into 1-inch cubes 1/2 red onion, cut in half and thinly sliced 20 basil leaves, coarsely chopped 3 tablespoons capers, drained FOR THE VINAIGRETTE 1 teaspoon finely minced garlic 1/2 teaspoon Dijon mustard 3 tablespoons champagne vinegar 1/2 cup olive oil 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper
directions: Heat a stove-top grill. Brush the bread with olive oil, sprinkle with salt, and grill for 10 minutes on each side, until nicely browned. If you don't have a stove-top grill, heat the oil in a large saute pan, add the bread and salt; cook over low to medium heat, tossing frequently, for 10 minutes, or until nicely browned. Add more oil as needed. For the vinaigrette, whisk together the garlic, mustard, vinegar, olive oil, salt, and pepper. In a large bowl, mix the tomatoes, cucumber, red pepper, yellow pepper, red onion, basil, and capers. Toss with enough vinaigrette to moisten. Season liberally with salt and pepper and arrange the vegetables artfully on a platter. Drizzle the bread with extra vinaigrette or olive oil and add to the platter. Serve immediately, or allow the salad to sit for about half an hour for the flavors to blend.

title: Jazzed Up Creole Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 3 -4 cups cooked shrimp (defrosted drained deveined, try also crabmeat, canned salmon, tuna even crawfish) Remoulade Sauce 1/4 cup mayonnaise 1/4 cup ketchup 1 tablespoon ponzu sauce 2 tablespoons relish or 2 tablespoons minced gherkins 1 sliced celery ribs or 1/2 cup sliced celery rib 1/4 cup green bell pepper, chopped fine (I mixed green and red bells) 2 2 scallions, sliced or 2 tablespoons sliced scallions (white and green) 1 large red radish, grated 1 garlic clove, grated 1 teaspoon horseradish 1 teaspoon mustard (creole or stone ground is best) 1/4 teaspoon celery seed 1/2 teaspoon paprika 1/4 teaspoon creole seasoning (more or less to taste) 4 -6 drops hot pepper sauce, to taste
directions: Place all the Remoulade Sauce ingredients in a bowl and mix to combine well. Taste and adjust seasoning to your likings. Add the shrimp and stir to coat. Chill for 2 hour for flavors to meld. Plate over greens, stuff into half an avocado,(my Favorite) or into a Baguette. Enjoy! FYI: If you don`t enjoy a chunky salad like sauce by all means blend it for a smooth dressing.

title: Corn Meal Porridge
ingredients: 1/3 cup quaker yellow cornmeal 2 cups water 1 pinch salt
directions: Boil 1 cup water and dash of salt (optional). mix together 1 cup water and corn meal together. when water reaches a boil pour mixture of corn meal and cup of water into boiling water and stir. cover let cook for 5 minutes or until thickened. Enjoy.

title: Curry Dip
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. curry powder 1/4 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. dry mustard 3/4 c. mayonnaise 1/2 Tbsp. finely grated onion Tabasco sauce to taste
directions: Stir together curry powder, salt and mustard. Gradually whisk in the mayonnaise, keeping smooth. Whisk in onion and Tabasco. Chill, covered tightly, for 2 hours or overnight so flavor has time to develop thoroughly. Makes 3/4 cup.

title: Crispy Kinako and Salt Cookies
ingredients: 100 grams Flour (or strong bread flour) 30 grams Kinako 40 grams Sugar 50 grams Vegetable oil 1 1/4 tsp Salt 1 A durable plastic bag
directions: Combine all of the ingredients except for the vegetable oil in a plastic bag. Give the bag a good shake to evenly mix the ingredients, then add the vegetable oil. Massage the contents in the bag from the outside until you get an even consistency. Shape the dough into a log inside the bag. Chill in the freezer for about 15-20 minutes to make slicing easy. Cut open the bag and slice into 1 cm thicknesses. No need to dirty up your cutting board. Arrange the cookies on a baking sheet and bake in oven preheated to 170 C for 15 minutes. Then they're ready! When they first come out of the oven, they are surprisingly hot and fragile. Be patient enough not to touch them until after they cool down. I tried them using strong bread flour. While they turned out a bit light tasting, they were crisp and crumbly. Give it a try.

title: Baked Beans
ingredients: 1 family sized can pork and beans 1/2 c. brown sugar 1/2 tsp. mustard 1 small can tomato sauce 2 Tbsp. vinegar 1 Tbsp. chopped onion 3 bacon slices
directions: Mix all ingredients in baking dish. Cover with bacon. Bake at 350° for 1 hour. Serve hot.

title: Green Jello Salad
ingredients: 1 large pkg. lime Jello 2 c. boiling water 1 1/2 c. small marshmallows 1 large cream cheese, softened 1 can crushed pineapple, drained 1 c. walnuts, chopped 1 3/4 c. cold water, or less if you use pineapple juice
directions: Pour boiling water over Jello to dissolve. Add marshmallows to melt. Add cream cheese and beat until broken up. Add remaining ingredients and chill.

title: Polpettone With Spinach and Provolone
ingredients: 1 cup cubed day-old bread, crusts removed 1 cup heavy cream 1 pound ground beef 1 pound ground pork 1 pound ground veal or turkey 1 tablespoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon coarsely ground black pepper Pinch of cayenne 1/4 teaspoon grated nutmeg 1 teaspoon chopped rosemary 1 teaspoon chopped thyme 2 teaspoons chopped sage 1 tablespoon chopped parsley 3 ounces grated Parmesan, about 1/2 cup 2 eggs, lightly beaten, plus 3 (8-minute) hard-boiled eggs, peeled, for filling 1/4 pound thinly sliced mortadella or prosciutto 1 pound spinach, briefly blanched, roughly chopped and squeezed dry 3 ounces provolone or caciocavallo, sliced 1/8-inch thick 1 cup fine dry bread crumbs, preferably homemade
directions: Put bread cubes in a small bowl, cover with cream and set aside to soak until softened, about 10 minutes. Put beef, pork and veal in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, pepper, cayenne, nutmeg, rosemary, thyme, sage and parsley. Add Parmesan and, using hands, knead seasoning into meat. Combine soaked bread (and any remaining cream) with beaten eggs, then pour mixture over seasoned meat and knead until well combined. Heat oven to 350 degrees. Line a 12-by-18-inch baking sheet with parchment or foil. Press ground meat mixture evenly over parchment to make a flat rectangle slightly smaller than the baking sheet. Top with slices of mortadella. Scatter cooked spinach evenly over mortadella. Break provolone slices into rough pieces and distribute over surface. Finish with hard-cooked egg chopped into chunks. Using parchment to help, roll the meat into a long cylinder with filling on the inside. With the long side facing you, first lift parchment and use it to roll meat to the center, pressing down to keep it in place. Then lift parchment on the opposite long side, bringing meat just past the center to overlap itself slightly. Pinch the seam of the meat together to keep filling in place. Sprinkle with half the dry crumbs. You will now have a cylinder approximately 15 inches long. Twist ends of parchment to firm the mixture, then transfer to a deep-sided baking dish or roasting pan, and place it seam-side down. Carefully remove and discard parchment. With hands, press firmly to form cylinder into a long loaf with rounded ends. Dust top and sides with remaining bread crumbs. (The polpettone may be prepared to this point several hours, or up to 24 hours, in advance; keep refrigerated and bring to room temperature before baking.) Bake for 40 to 45 minutes, until internal temperature is 140 degrees. Let rest for 10 minutes and cut into 1-inch-thick slices and serve. (Alternatively, cool to room temperature and refrigerate for up to 3 days. If serving cold, cut thinner slices.)

title: Chicken A La King
ingredients: 1/3 c. mushrooms 1/4 c. chopped green pepper 1/4 c. butter 1/2 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper 1 c. chicken broth 1 c. cream 1 c. diced cooked chicken 1/4 c. chopped pimento 1/4 c. flour
directions: Saute mushrooms and green pepper in butter. Blend in flour and seasonings. Cook over low heat, stirring, until mixture is smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat. Slowly stir in broth and cream. Bring to boil over low heat, stirring constantly. Boil for 1 minute. Add chicken and pimento; continue cooking until meat is heated through. Serve over noodles.

title: Shrimp and Spinach Noodle Soup
ingredients: 8 cups water 1 pound pasta (i.e., spaghetti, capellini, linguine, rice noodles) 3 packets wonton soup base 16 shrimp, peeled and deveined 1 pound spinach
directions: Bring water to a boil with salt in a large pasta pot. Cook the pasta. In a medium saucepan, bring 8 cups of water to a boil. Add the soup base, shrimp, and spinach. Let simmer for 3 minutes. Divide the pasta among four bowls. Pour soup over the noodles.

title: Jen'S Crepes
ingredients: 4 eggs 1 3/4 cups cold milk 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 cup flour, sifted 3 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted (or oil)
directions: In blender, briefly mix together the eggs, milk and salt. Add flour and butter or oil. Blend for one minute. Let rest covered in refrigerator for 2 hours (This improves the texture but I usually skip this step.) Heat a 10 inch, non-stick skillet on med-high heat. Pour 1/4 cup of batter into tilted pan; swirl around until bottom of pan is covered with a thin layer of batter. Cook until edges start to curl away from sides of pan, (you may have to adjust heat if it's too hot) then using your fingers and a spatula peel and flip the crepe over. Let cook for few seconds or until you can shake it loose and slide it onto a plate. We like to spread one TBS of lemon curd down the middle of one crepe then roll it up like a cigar. This is also very good with a little bit of cottage cheese and lemon curd. Sometimes we use jam or even a little brown sugar. It's all good!

title: Corton
ingredients: 1 to 2 lb. ground pork 1 tsp. garlic salt 1 tsp. onion salt salt and pepper to taste 1 tsp. allspice pinch of cloves
directions: Place ground pork in a large pan and cover 1/2-inch above meat with water. Boil for 1 hour, keeping water to meat level. Add garlic and onion salt. After boiling for 1 hour, add allspice and cloves. Continue to boil and simmer for another hour. When done simmering, pour into bowl and let cool completely before refrigerating.

title: Spicy Baked Salmon
ingredients: 1 lb salmon fillet 3 green onions, chopped 14 cup balsamic vinegar 14 cup olive oil 2 tablespoons soy sauce 1 tablespoon red chili pepper flakes 3 garlic cloves, minced
directions: Combine all ingredients in a large resealable bag. Marinate for 4 hours or overnight. Preheat oven to 375F. Line the pan with aluminum foil to make for an easy cleanup. Place salmon in a 9" x 13"inch pan and pour remaining marinade over the top. Bake for 3040 minutes, until cooked through.

title: Applesauce-Pecan Bread
ingredients: 2 c. flour 1/2 tsp. salt 3/4 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/4 tsp. nutmeg 1/2 c. chopped pecans 1/2 c. raisins 1 egg, beaten 1 c. applesauce 1/4 c. vegetable oil
directions: Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl. Stir in pecans and raisins. Make a well in center of mixture. Combine egg, applesauce and oil; add to dry ingredients, stirring just until moistened. Spoon mixture into a greased and floured 8 1/2 x 4 1/4 x 3-inch loaf pan. Bake at 350° for 40 to 45 minutes. Remove from pan. Let cool on wire rack.

title: Nori Roll Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1/4 cup soy sauce 1/4 cup sugar 2 tablespoons hot water 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice wasabi powder (optional) or chili paste with garlic, to taste (optional)
directions: In a small bowl, stir together all ingredients.

title: Caribbean Peanut Crusted Pork Loin
ingredients: 1/2 cup peanuts, spicy 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon allspice 1 teaspoon thyme 1/2 teaspoon cayenne 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon 2 limes, juice of 1/2 yellow onion, minced 3 -4 lbs pork loin, trimmed 1 teaspoon ground dried chile (optional)
directions: Preheat oven to 350°F. In a food processor, grind the peanuts and garlic, and pulse to the consistency of coffee grounds. (If you can't get the prepared peanuts, use peanuts and add in 1 tsp of dried ground chile, red or green, but hot!). In a mixing bowl, combine the nut mixture with the remaining ingredients, except the pork. Stir well, then coat the pork with this mixture. Heat a wide, ovenproof pan over medium-high heat and put a little oil inches When hot, sear the nut encrusted pork loin for 2 - 3 minutes on 2 sides. Put this pan with the pork in the oven and roast for 1 hour 20 minutes, or until done. Remove, and rest for 10 minutes. Slice the pork into thin medallions. Spoon some Vanilla Yams in the center of each plate, then place 4 slices of pork on top of that. Ladle 1/4 cup Curried Mango Sauce across the pork. Serve with a spicy chutney on the side.

title: Cabbage Casserole
ingredients: whole cabbage 1 lb. ground beef 1 onion 2 eggs 2 slices bread 2 Tbsp. milk 1 c. shredded Cheddar cheese
directions: Slow-cook cabbage (cut in quarters) in water until done. Scramble ground beef and onion until beef is done. Drain cabbage and ground beef; mix together. Add salt and pepper.

title: Crock Pot Low Fat Refried Pinto Beans
ingredients: 1 (8 ounce) bag dried pinto beans 1/4 yellow onions or 1/4 white onion, finely chopped 1 teaspoon cumin 2 teaspoons garlic powder 1 teaspoon chili powder 2 teaspoons salt 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes
directions: Soak beans overnight or for 8 hours. Discard floating beans and beans that are cracked. Rinse beans thoroughly under cold water. Add beans to Crockpot, cover with 1" of water. Add salt - approximately 1 tablespoon. Add approximately 1 teaspoon of garlic & chili powders. Add 1 1/2 (approx) of cumin. Sprinkle red pepper flakes. Cook on low 4-6 hours or until beans are tender. Once beans are done transfer some of your beans to the Cuisnart. Add some of your cooking water. Mix until blended.

title: Savory Meatballs
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 3 Tbsp. chopped onion 3-4 Tbsp. milk 3/4 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper 1/4 tsp. poultry seasoning 1 can cream of chicken soup 3/4 c. hot water Chopped parsley
directions: Mix all ingredients together and form into meatballs about 1 inch in diameter. Brown in a skillet over medium heat; drain. For sauce, mix the soup and water together and pour over browned meatballs. Cover and simmer 45 minutes. Garnish with chopped parsley. These are super served on a bed of noodles or rice.

title: Macaroni And Beef
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. hamburg 1/2 lb. uncooked elbow macaroni 1/2 c. onion, chopped 1/2 c. green pepper, chopped 2 (8 oz.) cans tomato sauce 1 c. water 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1 to 1 1/2 Tbsp. Worcestershire sauce
directions: Cook beef in skillet; remove beef. Cook macaroni, onion and green pepper in meat fat. Return meat along with tomato sauce, water, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce. Cover and simmer 25 minutes or until macaroni is cooked to taste.

title: Pan Roasted Duck Breasts With Roasted Honey Plums
ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons honey 8 ripe black plums, halved, pitted 2 fresh rosemary sprigs 1 cup ruby port 1 tablespoon butter 4 muscovy duck breasts
directions: Heat honey in heavy large skillet over medium heat until bubbles form. Add plums, cut side down and cook unti light brown, rearranging plums occasionally to cook evenly and adding water by tablespoonfuls as needed to prevent burning, about 8 minutes. Turn plums over. Tuck rosemary sprigs between plums. Cook 3 minutes. Transfer plums to a plate. Add port to skillet and simmer until sauce is reduced to 2/3 cup, stirring and scraping up any browned bits, about 3 more minutes. Mix in butter. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Return plums to skillet. (Can be prepared 4 hours ahead, letting stand at room temperature.). Using shapr kinife, score duck skin every 3/4 inch on diagonal, cutting almost throught to meat. repeat in opposite direction, creating 3/4 inch diamond pattern. Sprinkle duck with salt and pepper. Place duck, skin side down in skillet over midium heat; cook until skin is brown and crisp and the fat has rendered, about 9 minutes. Turn duck and cook to desired doneness, about 5 minutes longer for medium-rare. Transfer duck to plate; tent with foil to keep warm. Let rest 5 minutes. Rewarm plums with sauce over medium heat, turning plums occasionally, about 3 minutes. cut duck crosswise into into 1/3 inch slices and fan on plates. Garnish with plum halves; spoon sauce over duck and serve.

title: Swedish Apple Cake
ingredients: 3 c. flour 2 c. sugar 1 tsp. soda 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. salt 1 1/4 c. cooking oil 3 eggs, beaten 2 tsp. vanilla 3 c. raw apples, diced 1 c. nuts (optional)
directions: Stir first 5 ingredients together in a large bowl. Make a well in center and add remaining ingredients. Stir until well mixed; do not beat. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 55 minutes or until it springs back when touched lightly in center.

title: Allison'S Taco Wings
ingredients: 18 -24 chicken wings 2 (1 1/4 ounce) packages taco seasoning (we like Old El Paso) 1/8 cup vinegar 1/8 cup oil 1 dash cayenne pepper (or more to taste)
directions: Clean chicken wings, cut at the joints into three pieces and discard wing tips. In a large resealable plastic bag, combine the taco seasoning, vinegar, oil and cayenne by "squishing" the bag to make a paste. Add the chicken wing pieces, seal the bag and "squish" until the paste is distributed evenly over the chicken pieces (if the paste is too thick then add a small amount of vinegar or water -- but remember it is a paste - almost a rub). Marinate chicken 1 hour at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator. Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread wings pieces on a baking sheet lined with foil (for easiest clean-up). Try to maintain some space between each piece - use a second baking sheet if necessary. Brush pieces with any extra paste. Bake at 400 for 1 to 1 1/4 hours, turning half way through the baking time. Can be held in a crock pot to serve at a party or buffet.

title: Shrimp Scampi
ingredients: 1/4 c. butter or margarine 2 lb. large shrimp, shelled and deveined 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/3 c. chopped parsley 2 Tbsp. lemon juice 3/4 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper
directions: Melt butter in large skillet; add shrimp and garlic. Saute, stirring constantly, for about 3 to 5 minutes or until shrimp turns pink. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook, stirring gently, for about 2 to 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

title: pastrami fried cabbage & noodles
ingredients: 2 onions thinly sliced 4 clove garlic crushed 2 can mushrooms drained 2 packages cole slow 3/4 tbsp salt 8 oz pastrami thin strips 1 black pepper 1 tbsp mustard 1 tsp sugar 1 lb bow tie noodles
directions: saute onions garlic mushrooms Cole slow & salt for about 30 - 35 min meanwhile cook noodles in water & abet salt & drain add the pastrami pepper & mustard to the Cole slow & saute for additional few min add the noodles mix well over a medium flame

title: Simple Crab Soup
ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter 2 medium red bliss or other waxy potatoes, cut into 1/2-inch dice 1 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons Old Bay seasoning, or as needed Salt 3 1/2 cups beef or vegetable stock, or as needed 2 tablespoons lemon juice, or as needed 1/2 cup dry white wine 2 large tomatoes, peeled and cut into 1/2-inch dice 1 pound claw crab meat, picked over and any cartilage discarded Saltines, for serving
directions: In a large, deep pot over medium-low heat, melt the butter. Add the potatoes and sprinkle with pepper, 2 tablespoons Old Bay and a pinch of salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2 to 3 minutes. Add 3 1/2 cups stock and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and add 2 tablespoons lemon juice, wine and tomatoes. Cover and cook until the potatoes are tender and the flavors melded, 20 minutes to 1 hour. Just before serving, add the crab and simmer just until thoroughly heated. If the soup seems too thick, add more stock as desired. Adjust the seasonings, adding salt, lemon or Old Bay to taste. Serve hot, with crackers.

title: Wild Western Chili Soup
ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1 c. chopped onion 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 can beef broth 2 (10 3/4 oz.) cans tomato soup 1 soup can water 2 (15 1/2 oz.) cans kidney beans 3 c. cooked elbow macaroni 3 Tbsp. chili powder 2 Tbsp. vinegar
directions: In large, heavy pan, brown meat, onion and garlic. Add remaining ingredients. Stir occasionally. Makes 12 cups.

title: Jam Cake
ingredients: 1/2 c. butter 1 1/2 c. blackberry jam, thick 1 tsp. baking soda 1 c. sugar 4 eggs, well beaten 1/4 c. sour milk 2 1/2 c. flour 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. allspice 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 3/4 tsp. salt
directions: Cream sugar and butter. Add eggs and jam. Beat thoroughly. Sift flour, measure and sift with baking soda, salt and spices. Add alternately with milk to first mixture, beat thoroughly. Pour into well-oiled pan. Bake at 375° about 45 minutes. Use brown sugar icing.

title: Pineapple Salsa Verde
ingredients: 2 cups Fresh Pineapple 3 cups Quartered Tomatillos 1/4 cups Red Onion 1 cup Fresh Cilantro 1 whole Jalapeno 1 teaspoon Salt 1 teaspoon Black Pepper
directions: Add everything to a blender. Puree on high until blended.

title: Sugar-Free Pumpkin Pie For My Sister
ingredients: 1 pkg. unflavored gelatin 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. ginger 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1/4 tsp. salt 2 eggs 1 (13 oz.) can evaporated milk 1 (16 oz.) can pumpkin 8 pkg. Equal or Sweet 'N Low
directions: Mix gelatin and spices and salt into a medium saucepan. Beat eggs and milk together and pour into pan with dry ingredients. Let stand 1 minute. Stir over low heat until dissolved, about 10 minutes or so. Remove from heat; stir in pumpkin and Equal. Pour mixture into a baked pie shell. Chill until firm.

title: Hamburger Bake
ingredients: 2 lb. hamburger 1 box Stove Top stuffing 1 can mushroom soup 1 can cream of chicken
directions: Using 9 x 13-inch pan, put browned, seasoned and drained crumbled hamburger in bottom. Prepare stuffing as directed on box, then spread on top of hamburger. Mix soups with 1 can of water and pour over dressing. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Cream of Broccoli Soup
ingredients: 4 cups fresh broccoli, chopped 1 large potato, chopped 1 small onion, chopped 2 cups water 1 12 cups almond milk
directions: Boil water. Add potato and onion. Simmer 10 minutes, til tender. Add chopped broccoli. Simmer til broc is bright green and take off heat. Cool til OK for blender. Put in blender and add almond milk. Blend to desired consistency. Possibly season in blender with dash of any or all of the following: thyme, curry, nutmeg, pepper.

title: Kale And Cranberry Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch kale 1 cup dried cranberries 1 cup sunflower seeds 1/2 cup lemon juice 3 cloves garlic 1/2 cup olive oil
directions: Mix oil and lemon juice together, add minced garlic and set aside. Cut up the kale in small pieces and remove the thick vein down the center. Pour the oil/juice mixture over the kale. Put in a container with a lid and shake well. Let the salad sit in the refrigerator for at least six hours-this allows the acid from the lemon juice to "cook" the leaves. When you're ready to serve, add the cranberries and sunflower seeds and toss.

title: Taffy Apple Salad
ingredients: 1/2 c. sugar 1 Tbsp. cornstarch 2 Tbsp. lemon juice 1 egg, beaten 1 (20 oz.) can pineapple chunks (save juice) 1 (8 oz.) Cool Whip 3 medium apples, cored and chopped (unpeeled) 2 c. miniature marshmallows 2 1/2 oz. nuts
directions: In saucepan, mix sugar, cornstarch, lemon juice, egg and pineapple juice. Cook over low heat until thick. Cool. Stir in Cool Whip. In large bowl, mix apples, pineapple, marshmallows and nuts. Toss with cooled dressing and chill 2 to 3 hours before serving.

title: Stuffed Mushrooms
ingredients: 1 large pkg. cream cheese, softened 7 pieces bacon, cooked 5 green onions 2 hand full of Mozzarella cheese garlic salt fresh mushrooms
directions: Mix all ingredients and pull stems off and stuff mushroom caps. Drop a few spoonfuls of butter on cookie sheet and place mushrooms on it. Bake for about 30 minutes at 350 degrees. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese when done.

title: Sparkling Sumac Lemonade Recipe
ingredients: 2 cups water 2 cups sugar 3 tablespoons ground sumac 1 cup club soda or seltzer 1/4 cup sumac syrup 1 tablespoon juice from 1 lemon, plus 1 lemon, cut into wedges
directions: Combine water and sugar in a small saucepan. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar is dissolved. All to cool to room temperature. Add sumac, stir to combine, and allow to infuse for 5 minutes. Strain through a fine mesh strainer. Sumac syrup can be stored in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 5 days. For each serving, combine 1 cup club soda, 1/4 cup sumac syrup, and 1 tablespoon lemon juice in a cup. Add ice and stir. Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

title: Glenn'S Southern Corn Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cornmeal 2 eggs 310 g creamed corn 1/2 cup oil 4 tablespoons flour 1/2 teaspoon baking powder 1 large onion, chopped 4 jalapeno peppers, chopped 1 cup buttermilk 250 g tasty cheese, grated
directions: Preheat oven to 190 degrees celcius. Mix all ingredients together. Pour into a greased 9 x 9 x 2 inch pan, bake for 60 minutes.

title: Crab Dip
ingredients: 1 (8 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1 Tbsp. milk 1 can crab meat 2 Tbsp. onion, chopped 2 tsp. Worcestershire 1/2 tsp. horseradish, prepared 1/4 tsp. salt dash of black pepper 2 Tbsp. slivered almonds
directions: Combine everything but almonds. Sprinkle almonds on top. Bake at 375° for 15 minutes. Serve with crackers.

title: Grilled Chicken Salad With Cantaloupe
ingredients: 1 medium ripe mango, peeled seeded, chopped 2 cleaned boneless chicken breasts 6 jumbo pasta shells 1/2 cantaloupe, seeded diced 1/4 cup sour cream 1 tablespoon fresh chives, minced 2 tablespoons lime juice 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard
directions: Season chicken breasts with salt pepper and seasonings which you like. Grill chicken.T. hen cool cut in to small pieces. Set aside. Cook pasta according to directions on package. Rinse with cold water and set aside. Combine diced mango and melon, chicken and rest of ingredients; stuff shells.

title: Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 or 2 doz. corn tortillas 2 lb. ground chuck 4 medium onions, chopped 2 cans black olives, chopped 2 pkg. grated low-fat cheese 2 cans enchilada sauce 1 small can tomato sauce
directions: I cook these until heated through, at about 350° or 400°, if desired to be browned.

title: Gingered Tomato Broth with Pappadam Noodles
ingredients: 12 large spinach 1 tablespoon peanut oil 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 1/2 tablespoons ginger grated 1 teaspoon jalapeno pepper 1/4 teaspoon turmeric 3 each tomatoes peeled, seeded, diced 5 cups stock 2 tablespoons cilantro chopped
directions: Using scissors, cut pappadams into 1 inch wide noodles. Stack spinach leaves, roll them into a tight log, and cut into 18 inch chiffonade. Heat oil over moderate heat. Add cumin seeds, ginger and jalapeno, fry until seeds darken slightly. Stir in turmeric and tomato and cook about 4 to 5 minutes. Add stock and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover and simmer for 15 minutes. Season. Just before serving, add noodles and spinach and simmer for a bare minute. Ladle into warmed bowls and garnish with cilantro.

title: Spinach Salad
ingredients: bacon, cooked and crumbled 1 c. olive oil 1/2 tsp. dry mustard 1/2 tsp. onion juice salt and pepper to taste 1/3 c. vinegar 1 pack fresh spinach
directions: Cook bacon and set aside to cool. Combine remaining ingredients in blender. Let set for several hours to combine flavors.

title: Caramel Cinnamon Cake Squares
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups ap flour 1 tablespoon cornstarch 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 cup white sugar 1/3 cup unsalted butter 1 egg 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 cup whole milk 5 squares caramel candy 1 tablespoon milk 1/4 cup dark brown sugar 2 tablespoons unsalted butter melted 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. and butter an 8-inch baking dish. In a large bowl, sift together flour, cornstarch and baking powder. Set aside. In the bowl of your stand mixer, beat together sugar and butter until soft. Add in egg, vanilla and milk until well combined. Gradually add in dry ingredients until mixture is smooth. Pour batter into baking dish and set aside. In a small saucepan over medium heat, soften caramel candies with milk. Once soft, add butter, sugar and cinnamon until everything has melted together, like a thick syrup. Drizzle the caramel topping over the cake batter and gently drag a knife through the batter and swirl the topping into the batter. Bake for about 25-30 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean. Try it and love it! *NOTE: You may substitute the 11/2 cups AP Flour and tablespoon Cornstarch with 11/2 cups Cake Flour.

title: Veggie Bacon Quiche
ingredients: 1 uncooked 9-inch pie shell 1 cup zucchini, coarsely chopped 1/2 cup green bell pepper, diced 1/2 cup red bell pepper, diced 4 -5 slices bacon, cut into 3/4-inch pieces 1 small chopped onion 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 4 eggs 1 cup evaporated milk 1 tablespoon coarse grain mustard 2 tablespoons flour parsley or red pepper flakes, to garnish (to garnish)
directions: Precook piecrust in preheated 350-degree oven (prevents soggy crust). In a large skillet, fry the bacon pieces until they are crisp. Set bacon aside to drain on paper towel, but do not discard bacon drippings. Saute the onions, zucchini and peppers in the bacon drippings. Drain the vegetables well and put them in the precooked crust followed by cheese. Blend eggs, mustard, flour, and evaporated milk and pour the mixture into piecrust over other ingredients. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes. After about 35 minutes of baking time, spread the cooked bacon pieces over the pie and sprinkle some more shredded cheese on top. Pie is cooked when knife comes out clean when inserted in pie. Let set for 5 minutes or so before cutting. Garnish as desired and serve hot, warm, or cold.

title: Quick Custard Pie
ingredients: 4 eggs, beaten 3/4 to 1 c. sugar 1/4 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla 2 1/2 to 3 1/2 c. milk, scalded
directions: Preheat oven to 450°. Beat first 4 ingredients until all sugar is dissolved. Slowly add the scalded milk to the egg mixture. Pour into a 9-inch unbaked pie shell. Bake for 15 minutes or until custard is set.

title: Taco Dip
ingredients: 8 oz. cream cheese 1/4 c. sour cream 1/2 c. shredded cheese 4 c. shredded lettuce 12 oz. small curd cottage cheese 1 large chopped tomato 1 pkg. taco seasoning
directions: Blend with electric mixer cream cheese, cottage cheese, sour cream and taco seasoning. Spread on serving platter and cover with shredded lettuce, then layer of chopped tomatoes and last of shredded cheese. More cheese can be added.

title: Creamy Salmon Quiche
ingredients: pastry for 9-inch pie 1 (7 3/4 oz.) can salmon 1 (6 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 2 Tbsp. lemon juice 1/4 tsp. salt 1/2 c. heavy cream 4 eggs, separated pimiento (for garnish)
directions: Line a 9-inch pie plate with pastry. Drain salmon, reserving the liquid, and sprinkle salmon chunks over the bottom of pastry. Combine the cream cheese and lemon juice. Gradually beat in reserved salmon liquid, salt and cream. Beat egg yolk and cheese mixture. Spoon over the salmon in the pastry lined pan. Bake in preheated 375° oven for 45 minutes or until top is lightly browned and the filling is set. Garnish with pimiento "fish." Serve hot in wedges to 6.

title: Coconut Cake
ingredients: 3 eggs 1/2 tsp. salt 1 c. sugar granulated 2/3 c. butter 1/3 c. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 2 c. flour 3 tsp. baking powder 1 can baking coconut (6 or 8 oz. can)
directions: Separate white of eggs in small bowl. Mix egg yolk, butter and sugar together. Add dry ingredients; beat. Then add milk and coconut. Beat white of eggs until stiff; fold into cake mix. Pour in two 8-inch cake pans. Bake at 350° for 35 minutes.

title: Raspberry Salad
ingredients: 2 (3 oz.) pkg. raspberry jello 1 can whole cranberries 1 pt. raspberry sherbet 1 can crushed pineapple, drained Dream Whip
directions: Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water (use pineapple juice if desired). Add cranberries. Stir until dissolved. Add raspberry sherbet. Mix well. Fold in pineapple. Pour into 13 x 9-inch pan. Chill until firm. Frost with Dream Whip.

title: Colcannon
ingredients: 6 whole Potatoes, Peeled And Quartered 1 whole Sweet Onion, Chopped Medium Fine 1/2 whole Cabbage, Shredded Finely As For Coleslaw (or 1 Package Angel Hair Shredded Cabbage) 1 Tablespoon Salt, Or To Taste 1-1/2 stick Butter, Divided 1/2 cups Cream
directions: Peel and quarter the potatoes and cover with water. Add salt. Bring to a boil and cook until fork-tender. Mash with 1/2 stick butter and 1/2 cup cream. Meanwhile, melt remaining stick of butter in a skillet and add chopped onion and shredded cabbage. Reduce heat to low and cover skillet. Do not brown, just cook until onion is translucent. Stir mashed potatoes into cabbage-onion mixture and adjust seasonings. Great with ham. Serves six.

title: Homemade Yeast Rolls
ingredients: 1 c. boiling water 2 tsp. salt 1 c. sugar 2 pkg. dry yeast 7 c. flour 3/4 c. shortening 1 c. cold water 2 eggs 1/2 c. lukewarm water
directions: In first bowl, mix boiling water, shortening and salt. In second bowl, mix cold water, sugar and eggs. In third bowl, dissolve yeast in lukewarm water. Mix all three bowls together and add flour until it makes stiff dough. Spread oil on top of the dough to keep soft. Cover bowl with wet towel and let rise overnight. Roll dough and cut out. Let rise for 2 hours. Bake at 400° until done.

title: Taco Soup
ingredients: 2 lb. ground beef 1 onion, chopped 2 cans stewed tomatoes 2 cans whole kernel corn 2 cans chili beans or pinto beans 2 pkg. Taco Mix (mild) 2 pkg. Ranch dressing 4 c. water Optional toppings: sour cream, grated cheese
directions: Brown and drain beef and onion. Add all other ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 1 hour. Serve over tortilla chips. Top with sour cream and grated cheese.

title: White Bread
ingredients: 1 (1/4 ounce) package active dry yeast 5 teaspoons butter (or 1 1/2 tb) 14 cup milk 5 teaspoons sugar (or 1 1/2 tb) 1 teaspoon salt 2 12-3 12 cups unbleached white flour nonstick cooking spray
directions: Mix yeast according to directions on the packet. Melt the butter in the microwave, then add it, the milk, the sugar, and the salt to the yeast liquid and stir it up until everything looks the same (a very light tan liquid). Add two cups of flour to the mix. Start stirring, and then add the flour about 1/4 cup at a time every minute or so until the dough is still slightly sticky. Flour your hands and surface for kneading. Then grab the dough ball out of the bowl, slap it down on the table, and start beating on it. Do this for ten minutes. Punch it flat, then fold it back up into a ball again, and repeat several times, squeeze and twist it. Shape into a ball, place in a bowl coated with cooking spray, cover bowl with cloth or towel. Place somewhere fairly warm for an hour. This is a good time to clean everything else and put the stuff away, but leave the flour out and the floured area on your table untouched. After an hour, it should be roughly double the size that it was before, but dont sweat it too much if its larger or smaller than that, as long as it rose at least some amount. Punch the dough down (three or four good whacks will cause it to shrink back down to normal). You can cover again for another hour and let it rise again. I find this makes lighter, fluffier bread. If you don't have another hour, proceed to next step. Lay the dough out on the floured area and spread it out in a rectangle shape, with one side being roughly the length of the bread pan and the other side being about a bread pan and a half long. Then, roll it up! The roll should be roughly the same size as the bread pan. Spray the bread pan with nonstick cooking spray, place dough in the pan, cover that loaf up with the towel, put it back where it was before, and wait another hour. Cook at 400 degrees for 30 minutes. Immediately remove it from the pan to cool. Let it cool down completely before slicing.

title: Quick Turkey 'n' Stuffing
ingredients: 1 skinless boneless turkey breast, about 1-1/3 pounds (PERDUE Fit 'n' Easy suggested) 1 14 teaspoons poultry seasoning salt and pepper 6 tablespoons butter, divided 12 cup chopped onion 1 (6 ounce) package turkey stuffing mix or 1 (6 ounce) package chicken
directions: With a sharp knife, cut a deep pocket in side of breast. Rub all over with poultry seasoning, and salt and pepper to taste. In large, nonstick skillet over medium heat, melt 4 tablespoons butter. Add onion and saute 2-3 minutes, until softened. Prepare stuffing mix following package directions adding onion and butter mixture. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Stuff breast and secure with toothpicks. Place any remaining stuffing in a greased, shallow roasting pan; place breast on top. Dot top of breast with remaining 2 tablespoons butter. Bake 35-40 minutes, until turkey is lightly browned and meat thermometer inserted in thickest part registers 170 degrees F. To serve: remove toothpicks and slice turkey.

title: Stripe Bass
ingredients: 1/2-1pound striped bass/sea bass flour white or red cooking wine lemon butter olive oil
directions: Remove skin Cut fish in to strips Dust with flour on both sides In a large frying pan add 1 tablespoon butter and add oil. Add fish. When the fish is golden on both sides add a heavy splash of wine. Cook for 1 more minute remove and squeeze lemon on top

title: Apple Cinnamon Cake
ingredients: 1 pkg. spice or yellow cake mix 1 (21 oz.) can Thank You apple pie filling 3 eggs 3 Tbsp. sugar 1 tsp. cinnamon
directions: Preheat oven to 350°. Blend together cake mix, pie filling and eggs in large mixer bowl. Beat at medium speed 2 minutes. Combine sugar and cinnamon.

title: Hot Roast Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 5 lb. chuck roast 1 envelope onion soup mix 1 can cream of mushroom soup
directions: Bake together 4 to 5 hours at 200° to 250°. Shred beef. If needed, add crushed Town House crackers to meat and juices.

title: Cherry Pie Muffins
ingredients: 2 cup bisquick 1/2 cup sugar 1 egg 2/3 cup milk 1 tsp vanalla 2 tbsp oil 1/4 cup sour cream 1 cup cherry pie filling (maybe a lil more or a lil less )
directions: preheat oven to 400F spray bottom of muffin pans or liners (about 12 ~15) in med bowl add bisquisk and sugar in small bowl add milk,egg,oil,vanilla, mix well then add to bisquick and sugar and mix together by hand and then fold in sour cream add spoonful of batter to liners then add a spoonfull of pie filling and top off with another spoonfull of batter continue till batter is gone bake at 400F for 15 ~18 min or untill golden brown be sure not to over fill liners and let cool when finished filling is very hot

title: Boiled Eggs
ingredients: eggs water salt (brings water to a boil quicker)
directions: Put eggs in single layer in saucepan. Add enough tap water to cover eggs about 1 inch. Quickly bring water to boiling. Boil on medium to high heat 2 to 3 minutes. Remove from heat. Let eggs stand covered in the hot water 10-15 minutes for large eggs. Run cold water over eggs until cooled. To remove shell, gently tap all over. Roll egg between the hands to loosen shell, then peel, starting at large end. Hold egg under running cold water or dip in bowl of water to help ease off shell.

title: Vegan Whole Wheat Biscuits
ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat pastry flour 4 teaspoons baking powder 1 tablespoon stevia powder 3/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 cup coconut oil, at room temperature 1 cup almond milk
directions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees F (230 degrees C). Mix flour, baking powder, stevia powder, and salt in a bowl. Cut in coconut oil with a pastry cutter or knife until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Stir in almond milk until dough is just moistened. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface; knead gently 8 to 10 times. Pat or roll the dough out into a 3/4 inch thick round. Cut circles with a 2 1/2-inch biscuit cutter and arrange biscuits on a baking sheet. Bake in preheated oven until lightly browned, 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Early Morning Fruit Salad
ingredients: 8 large strawberries 1 small pineapple 4 small tangerines 1/4 cup honey 1 dash each cinnimon, ginger, cloves, nutmeg
directions: peel and trim fruit, then cut up mix honey and spices in small glass bowl and microwave for 15 seconds drizzle over fruit and mix together serve and enjoy. :-)

title: Barbecue Baked Beans
ingredients: pork and beans, drained brown sugar barbecue sauce raisins apples, chopped onions, chopped bacon
directions: Mix all ingredients except bacon in baking dish. Cover top with bacon strips. Bake until bubbly.

title: Easy Cherry Cobbler
ingredients: 2 c. Bisquick 1/2 c. milk 1 (21 oz.) can cherry pie filling 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/3 c. water
directions: Combine Bisquick and milk; stir until soft dough forms. Beat vigorously 20 strokes. Shape dough into ball on a floured surface. Knead lightly 5 times. Roll dough to 1/2-inch thickness. Cut into eight 2 1/2-inch rounds using a floured biscuit cutter. Mix cherry pie filling with cinnamon and water. Pour into a 9-inch square baking pan. Top with dough rounds. Bake in a 400° oven until dough topping is golden brown (about 25 to 30 minutes).

title: Sweet Potato Cake with Coconut Frosting
ingredients: Butter flavored cooking spray (recommended: Mazola Pure) 1 (18.25-ounce) box spice cake mix 2 cups leftover mashed candied sweet potatoes or yams 3 eggs 1 teaspoon coconut extract 1 1/4 cups evaporated milk 1/4 cup vegetable oil 2 (12-ounce) cans whipped cream cheese frosting 1 1/2 teaspoons rum extract 3/4 cup leftover cranberry sauce, drained if necessary 2 1/2 cups shredded coconut
directions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Lightly spray 2 (8 or 9-inch) round cake pans with butter flavored cooking spray; set aside. In a large mixing bowl, combine cake mix, mashed sweet potatoes, eggs, coconut extract, evaporated milk, and oil. Use an electric mixer to beat on low speed for 30 seconds. Scrape down sides of bowl and beat for 2 minutes on medium speed. Divide batter between prepared cake pans. Bake in preheated oven for 45 to 55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in middle of cakes comes out clean. Let cakes cool in pan for 10 minutes. Invert onto a wire cooling rack to cool completely. In a medium mixing bowl, combine frosting and rum extract; set aside. Place 1 of the cooled cake layers on serving plate. Cut a triangle from the bottom corner of a small zip-top bag. Spoon 1/4 cup of frosting into bag and secure top with 1 hand. Use other hand to guide bag and squeeze a thick border of frosting around the edge of the cake layer. Spoon cranberry sauce in the center of frosting border. Carefully place the other cake layer on top. Frost cake with remaining frosting. Sprinkle with coconut and gently pat to adhere to frosting. Slice and serve.

title: Simple Southern Watermelon Lemonade
ingredients: FOR THE SIMPLE SYRUP: 1 cup Sugar 1 cup Water FOR THE WATERMELON LEMONADE: 4 cups Cold Water 1 cup Freshly Squeezed Lemon Juice 6 cups Watermelon, Seedless 8 leaves Mint
directions: For the simple syrup, heat sugar and water in a small saucepan on low until sugar is dissolved completely. The sugar will go from cloudy to clear once it is dissolved. For the watermelon lemonade, add cold water to a pitcher. Pour the simple syrup into the pitcher. Add freshly squeezed lemon juice. Puree the watermelon in a food processor or blender. Strain the watermelon puree with a fine mesh. You should be left with 4 cups of watermelon juice. Add the watermelon juice to the pitcher. Break up mint leaves and add to the pitcher. Stir well and enjoy or refrigerate.

title: Cauliflower Steak with Curry Potato Mash
ingredients: 2 whole Potatoes 1 cup Milk 2 Tablespoons Olive Oil, Divided 2 teaspoons Salt 2 teaspoons Ground Black Pepper 1/2 whole Shallot Finely Minced 1 teaspoon Curry Powder Masala 1 head Cauliflower 4 Tablespoons Vegetable Oil 1 teaspoon Red Chili Flakes
directions: For the potatoes: Wash the potatoes and peel. Boil until fork-tender. While potatoes are warm, put them in a large bowl. Start to mash the potatoes, adding milk, 1 tablespoon olive oil, salt, pepper and finely minced shallot. Add curry masala powder and mix it all together. Put into a warm oven to keep warm. For the cauliflower steak: Use a sharp knife and cut the cauliflower, starting at the top, into 1 1/2-inch thick steaks. Baste cauliflower with vegetable or canola oil (or oil of your choosing). Sprinkle with salt, pepper and red chili flakes. Add remaining tablespoon of olive oil to a skillet and heat to medium high heat. Lay the first side of the cauliflower down and cook for 34 minutes each side until golden brown. Cook the second side the same way, Plate the potato mash and put the cauliflower steak on top of it.

title: Chicken And Rice Casserole
ingredients: 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 can cream of celery soup 1 c. uncooked white rice whole chicken or pieces
directions: Mix all ingredients together and spread evenly in ungreased 9 x 13-inch pan. Place chicken pieces on top and brush with melted butter. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 325° to 350°.

title: Cheesy Hash Browns
ingredients: 1 1/2 large pkg. hash browns 1 stick oleo 2 cans cream of mushroom soup 8 oz. grated Cheddar cheese 8 oz. sour cream 1 onion, chopped salt, pepper and garlic salt to taste corn flakes
directions: Melt butter (save 1/2 for topping). Mix all ingredients together. Top with 2 to 3 cups crushed corn flakes mixed with the reserved butter. Bake 1 hour at 350°.

title: Grilled Shrimp With Apricot Sauce For 2
ingredients: 1/4 cup apricot preserves 1 tablespoon apricot nectar 1/8 teaspoon ground chipotle powder 6 uncooked large shrimp, peeled and deveined 3 slices Canadian bacon, halved
directions: In a small bowl, combine the preserves, apricot nectar and chipotle powder. Chill until serving. Thread shrimp and bacon onto two metal or soaked wooden skewers. Grill, covered, over medium heat for 3-4 minutes on each side or until shrimp turn pink. Serve with sauce.

title: Steam Tapioca Pearl And Coconut /Kuih Sago
ingredients: 150 grams tapioca pearl (sago ) any colour optional 80 grams sugar 1 tsp vanilla extract 2 tsp corn starch 1 tsp salt 100 fresh grated coconut 2 tbsp honey
directions: soak tapioca pearl with cold water for 1 hour change water after 30 minute to removed excess starch mix all ingredient and steam it for 30 minutes once its slightly cool then cut steamed tapioca into shape and roll generously on salted coconut and and serve GARNISH OPTIONAL drizzle some honey over steam tapioca pearl with coconut

title: Poached Eggs in Mole with Creamy Green Rice
ingredients: 1/2 cup slivered raw almonds 2 tablespoons canola oil 3 cloves garlic, coarsely chopped 1 small Spanish onion, coarsely chopped 1 cup pureed plum tomatoes Scant 1/2 cup pureed chipotle in adobo 2 tablespoons ancho chile powder 1 tablespoon New Mexico chile powder 1/2 teaspoon ground chile de arbol 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves 1/4 cup chopped fresh mango 1/4 cup golden raisins 1/4 cup crushed blue corn tortilla chips 3 tablespoons molasses 1 tablespoon honey 1 tablespoon pure maple syrup 1 1/2 cups chicken stock, warmed 1 ounce semisweet or bittersweet chocolate, finely chopped Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 4 large eggs Creamy Green Rice, recipe follows 1/4 pound Cotija cheese, grated 1/4 pound queso fresco, grated Fresh cilantro leaves 1 1/2 cups heavy cream 1 1/2 cups long grain white rice Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh cilantro 3 green onions, thinly sliced 2 roasted poblano chiles, finely diced
directions: Put the almonds in a medium saucepan over medium heat and cook until lightly golden brown, stirring occasionally, about 5 minutes. Remove the almonds to a plate. Increase the heat to high, add the oil to the saucepan and heat until it begins to shimmer. Add the garlic and onions and cook until soft, about 4 minutes. Stir in the tomatoes, chipotle puree, the chile powders, cinnamon, allspice and cloves. Bring to a boil and cook for 10 minutes. Next, add the mangoes, raisins, corn tortillas, molasses, honey, maple syrup and almonds. Pour in the warmed chicken stock and cook, stirring occasionally, until the mangoes are soft and the mixture is reduced by half, about 50 minutes. Carefully transfer the mixture to a blender and blend until smooth. Return the mixture to the pan over high heat. Add the chocolate and cook until reduced to a sauce consistency, about 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F. Pour the mole into a medium, high-sided saute pan and bring to a simmer. Crack the eggs one a time into a ramekin and carefully slip into the mole. Sprinkle the tops of the eggs with salt and pepper. Transfer the pan to the oven and cook until the whites are just set and the yolks are still jiggly, about 12 minutes. Spoon some of the Creamy Green Rice into a shallow bowl and make an indention in the center. Put the egg in the center and spoon some of the mole over the egg. Sprinkle with the cheeses and garnish with cilantro leaves. Place the heavy cream in a small saucepan over high heat and bring to boil. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer until reduced by half. While the cream is reducing, bring 2 3/4 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan over high heat. Stir in the rice and season with salt. Bring to a boil again, stir, place a lid on the pan, reduce the heat to medium and cook until all of the liquid is absorbed, 15 to 18 minutes. Remove the rice from the heat and let sit for 5 minutes with the lid on. Remove the lid and fluff with a fork. Return the rice to the stove over medium heat, add the reduced cream and season with salt and pepper. Stir in the cilantro, green onions and poblanos.

title: Chiffon Pumpkin Pie
ingredients: 1 cup finely crushed gingersnaps (about 24) 3 tablespoons butter, melted 2 envelopes unflavored gelatin 1/2 cup fat-free milk 1/2 cup sugar 1 can (15 ounces) solid-pack pumpkin 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves 1 carton (8 ounces) frozen fat-free whipped topping, thawed Additional whipped topping, optional
directions: In a small bowl, combine cookie crumbs and butter. Press onto the bottom of a greased 9-in. springform pan; set aside. In a large saucepan, combine gelatin and milk; let stand for 5 minutes. Heat milk mixture to just below boiling; remove from the heat. Stir in sugar until dissolved. Add the pumpkin, salt, cinnamon, ginger and cloves; mix well. Fold in whipped topping. Pour over crust. Refrigerate until set, about 3 hours. Remove sides of pan just before serving. Garnish with additional whipped topping if desired.

title: Ww Margarita
ingredients: 1 (12 ounce) can diet Sprite 3 tablespoons lime juice Crystal Light sugar free low calorie lemonade mix (indiv package) tequila 15 ice cubes
directions: Mix together in shaker or in blender.

title: Punch
ingredients: 2 cans (12 oz.) frozen orange juice 1 can (12 oz.) lemonade or limeade 1 large can pineapple juice 1 pt. ginger ale 1/2 gal. vanilla ice cream 1 pt. orange sherbet 4 or 5 Tbsp. sugar
directions: Put all ingredients in punch bowl then start pouring 7-Up in until you finish filling punch bowl.

title: Frozen Chocolate Mousse Cake
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. semi-sweet chocolate chips 3 Tbsp. water 4 eggs, separated 1/4 c. sugar 1 c. heavy cream prepared graham cracker crust
directions: Combine and melt chocolate chips and water over a double boiler. Add egg yolks one at a time to this and beat after each one. In a small bowl, beat egg whites and sugar until stiff, like meringue. In a small bowl, whip the cream until stiff. Fold it all together and pour into graham cracker crust. Keep it frozen.

title: Italian Tomato, Onion, Bean & Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 can (15 Oz. Size) Cannellini Or Great White Northern Beans, Drained And Rinsed 2 whole Medium Sized Tomatoes, Cored And Cut Into Bite Size Pieces 2 cans (6 Oz. Size) Albacore Tuna In Water, Drained And Flaked But Not Too Finely 1/4 cups Sliced Sweet Onion 1/4 cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil 2 Tablespoons Chopped Fresh Basil 1/2 teaspoons Salt, Or To Taste 1/4 teaspoons Ground Black Pepper, Or To Taste
directions: Place all ingredients in a serving bowl. Toss, allow to sit at room temperature for 15 minutes. Serve.

title: Cherry Salad
ingredients: 2 pkg. cherry jello 2 c. boiling water 1 (No. 2) can cherry pie filling 1 (No. 2) can crushed pineapple 1 (10 oz.) pkg. cream cheese 1/2 c. chopped nuts sweet milk (enough added to cheese so it will spread)
directions: Mix jello and water; dissolve. Let stand 5 minutes. Add cherry and pineapple and pour 1/2 in pan and let chill. Mix cream cheese with milk and spread over jello. Sprinkle nuts on cheese. Add remaining jello. Refrigerate until firm.

title: Pasta La Cinenega
ingredients: 3/4 c. chopped green onions 2 cloves minced garlic 1/4 lb. Italian brown mushrooms, sliced 1/4 lb. baby white mushrooms, sliced 2 large shiitake mushrooms, sliced 1/4 tsp. black pepper 4 sliced medium zucchini 1 c. small broccoli flowerets 4 large Romano tomatoes, sliced 2 medium carrots, julienned 1 c. sliced snow peas 1 lb. asparagus, trimmed and sliced 2 Tbsp. minced fresh basil 2 Tbsp. minced fresh parsley 9 oz. spinach linguine, cooked al dente dry white wine 1 chopped small red onion
directions: Saute onions, garlic, mushrooms, basil, parsley, salt and pepper in white wine over medium heat. Blanch vegetables and set aside in large bowl. Add tomatoes to saute. Remove from heat, adding spice to taste. Toss with vegetables and serve over linguine.

title: Cold Tuna Salad
ingredients: 1 pkg. medium shell noodles 1 hard-boiled egg, chopped 1/2 c. diced celery 2 cans tuna 1/4 c. diced onion or 1 tsp. onion salt 2 c. Hellmann's mayonnaise
directions: Cook noodles as directed and drain. Mix in all ingredients. Put in a storage bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour before serving.

title: German Potato Salad
ingredients: 8 sliced potatoes, boiled until done 1 medium-sized onion, chopped 1/2 lb. bacon, fried and drained 1 Tbsp. flour 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. vinegar salt and pepper
directions: Combine potatoes and onion. Add fried bacon which has been broken into small pieces. Set aside.

title: Calla Lilies
ingredients: 4 eggs 1 c. flour 1 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. vanilla Cool Whip pineapple bits
directions: Beat eggs. Add sugar, then sifted dry ingredients. Drop by teaspoons on greased cookie sheet, no more than 6 at a time. Bake at 400° for 5 minutes or until lightly browned. Roll into cone shape while hot (before rolling fill with Cool Whip and pineapple); fasten with toothpicks.

title: Spicy Taco Burgers
ingredients: 1 12 lbs ground beef or 1 12 lbs ground turkey 1 (1 1/4 ounce) packet taco seasoning (I use store brand) 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs jalapeno jack cheese hot or mild rotel diced tomatoes with green chilies red onion sour cream or plain yogurt greens
directions: Mix the ingredients in a bowl and make patties. We prefer really thin ones. Put on the grill and cook until the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees. Put a few slivers of Cheese on each patty to melt. Place on whole wheat bun and top with Rotel, red onion, and sour cream (or yogurt). You can add greens too if you'd like. Too make it less spicy: add less of the seasoning packet to the meat; use cheddar cheese instead of Jalepeno; use plain diced tomatoes instead of Rotel Hot. Makes about 8 thin patties.

title: Pomegranate Salad
ingredients: 2 tablespoons sesame seeds 1/4 cup mild tasting olive oil 2 tablespoons pomegranate juice 2 tablespoons pomegranate molasses 2 tablespoons date syrup 2 tablespoons honey Himalayan pink salt or sea salt to taste Fresh ground black pepper to taste 9 oz bag romaine or butter lettuce 1/2 cup pomegranate seeds
directions: In a small dry skillet toast sesame seeds over medium heat until light brown in color, about 3 to 5 minutes. Pour sesame seeds out onto a paper towel to cool. Whisk together olive oil, pomegranate juice, pomegranate molasses, date syrup, honey, salt and pepper. Set aside. Arrange lettuce in large bowl or platter. Top with pomegranate seeds and sesame seeds, add dressing and toss. Serve immediately.

title: Panini with Grilled Chicken, Summer Squash & Red Pepper-Cilantro Pesto
ingredients: 2 whole Roasted Red Pepper, Chopped 3 Tablespoons Slivered Almonds, Toasted 1 clove Garlic, Chopped 13 cups Chopped Cilantro 3 Tablespoons Grated Parmesan Cheese 1- 1/2 teaspoon Freshly Squeeze Lime Juice 1/4 cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil 1/4 teaspoons Kosher Salt 1/4 teaspoons Freshly Ground Black Pepper 2 whole Boneless, Skinless Chicken Breasts 1 teaspoon Kosher Salt, Divided 1 teaspoon Freshly Ground Black Pepper, Divided 1 whole Small Summer Squash 1 Tablespoon Olive Oil 2 whole Wheat Ciabatta Rolls 4 ounces, weight Fresh Mozzarella, Thinly Sliced
directions: The pesto: Place roasted red bell peppers in the bowl of a food processor. Add slivered almonds, garlic, cilantro, Parmesan cheese, and lime juice. Pulse until combined. While the food processor is running, slowly pour in olive oil. Season with salt and pepper. Set the pesto aside. The panini: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Season chicken breasts with 1/2 teaspoon of kosher salt and 1/2 teaspoon of freshly ground black pepper. Grill until cooked through, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from the grill. Let rest 10 minutes, then cut into 1/2-inch slices, crosswise. Set aside. Cut summer squash lengthwise into four 1/2-inch slices. Place in a medium bowl and toss with olive oil, remaining kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper. Place on the grill and cook until tender, but not mushy, about 2 to 3 minutes per side. Cut ciabatta rolls in half horizontally. Spread each side of rolls with 1 tablespoons of the pesto (2 tablespoons per roll). Place 4 or 5 slices of grilled chicken on each roll, top each with 2 or 3 slices fresh mozzarella and 1 piece of summer squash, and top with other half of the roll. Place panini in a preheated panini maker or grill pan. If using a grill pan, use a brick (well washed and cover in foil) to place on top of the sandwiches to achieve the same effect as the panini maker. Cook until the bread is toasted and the cheese is starting to melt. Cut in half and serve immediately.

title: Lemon Lover'S Layer Cake
ingredients: Cake 3 cups sifted cake flour 1 tablespoon baking powder 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 cup unsalted butter, softened 2 cups sugar 1 tablespoon grated lemon zest 4 eggs 1 1/2 cups buttermilk 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla Filling 1 (10 ounce) jar lemon curd Frosting 2 cups heavy cream or 2 cups whipping cream 1/4 cup confectioners' sugar 1 cup sliced almonds, toasted
directions: Sift flour with baking powder, baking soda and salt in a mixing bowl and set aside. Cream butter, sugar, and grated lemon zest with an electric mixer in separate mixing bowl until pale and fluffy. Beat eggs in 1 at a time, thoroughly. With electric mixer on low, add flour mixture in thirds, alternating with buttermilk. Add vanilla and beat until smooth. Divide batter evenly between 2 buttered and floured 9 inch cake pans. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until cakes are golden and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. Cool. Removed cooled layers from pans. Cut layers in half horizontally with a serrated knife. Spread lemon curd evenly between the layers and stack on serving plate. Whip cream and confectioner's sugar together. Frost sides and top with whipped cream. Cover top and sides with sliced almonds, if desired.

title: Aji De Carne
ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil light 1 cup onions chopped 3 each scallions, spring or green onions chopped 1 tablespoon garlic 8 ounces pork loin 1 1/2 cups tomatoes 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads 1 small hot chili peppers 3/4 cup chicken broth 4 small russet potatoes 2 each bananas green, peeled 4 tablespoons milk, skim, (non fat) powder 4 each flour tortillas warmed 2 cups mixed salad greens
directions: Heat the oil in a Dutch oven casserole and saute the onions until almost soft. Add the garlic and cook until onions are soft. Add the pork, a few pieces at a time, and brown (char a little). Add the tomatoes, saffron, salt (if needed), black pepper, chile, cinnamon, cloves, and broth and optional annato. Bring to a boil, reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 40 to 50 mins. Add the potatoes and continue to cook until the potatoes are done, about 30 minutes. Add the bananas before the potatoes are done but the bananas need about 10 minutes at most. Make a well and tilt the pan so that the liquids pool. Pour the sauce ingredients gently combine; simmer until heated through, taking care that the "cream" does not boil. Serve immediately with warmed tortillas and mixed salad greens, undressed or a little lemon-lime juice.

title: Voodoo Juice
ingredients: Rums: Juices: Limes, cut for garnish Drinking Straws
directions: Premix first 4 rums in equal portions. Premix juices as specified. Fill tall glass w/ ice & squeeze of lime. Add flavored rum mixture. Add juice mixture leaving approx 1" at top -- mix. Top w/ generous splash of black strap (or dark) rum. Serve w/ Straw.

title: Deep Fried Chicken Squares Recipe
ingredients: 2 lbs. boned chicken 1 med. onion 3 tbsp. dry sherry 2 tbsp. soy sauce 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon sugar Oil for frying Flour
directions: Cut chicken with cleaver in 2 inch squares. Sauce: Chop onion and blend with sherry, soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Pour mix over chicken pcs; toss gently. Let stand for 1 hour. Heat oil to 350 to 375 degrees. Drain chicken and dip each piece in flour. Deep fry till golden (3 min). Drain on paper towel. Serve.

title: Braised Lamb With Rosemary And Garlic
ingredients: 2 teaspoons coriander seeds 4 garlic cloves, smashed 1/2 cup coarsely chopped rosemary 2 teaspoons dried oregano 2 teaspoons freshly ground black pepper 3/4 cup olive oil, divided 1 (6-pound) boneless leg of lamb, butterflied Kosher salt 1 medium onion, coarsely chopped 1 medium fennel bulb, coarsely chopped 1 medium carrot, peeled, coarsely chopped 1 head of garlic, halved crosswise 2 dried chiles de arbol or 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes 3/4 cup red wine Flaky sea salt and (for serving) A spice mill or a mortar and pestle
directions: Toast coriander seeds in a dry small skillet over medium heat, tossing often, until fragrant, about 2 minutes. Let cool; finely grind in spice mill or mortar and pestle. Pound garlic, rosemary, oregano, and pepper with a mortar and pestle or pulse in a food processor until garlic and rosemary are broken into fine pieces or finely chopped. Mix in coriander, then, stirring constantly, stream in 1/2 cup oil. Mix until a thick paste forms. Season lamb all over with kosher salt and spread half of the rosemary paste over inside of lamb. Starting from a short end, roll up lamb so it's resting seam side down. Starting at the center, tie with kitchen twine at even intervals. Rub outside of lamb with remaining rosemary paste and place on a rimmed baking sheet. Chill at least 4 hours and up to 12 hours (letting the lamb marinate longer will really allow the flavors to meld and permeate the meat). Remove lamb from refrigerator and let sit to come to room temperature, about 1 hour (this facilitates even cooking). Preheat oven to 450°F. Roast lamb until well browned all over, 20-25 minutes. Remove from oven and reduce oven temperature to 300°F. Meanwhile, heat remaining 1/4 cup oil in a Dutch oven or other heavy pot large enough to fit lamb over medium. Add onion, fennel, carrot, and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are soft and golden, 15-20 minutes. Add chiles de arbol and wine and bring to a simmer. Remove from heat. Carefully place lamb in pot and pour in water to come halfway up sides of meat. Place in oven and braise lamb, uncovered, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part registers 120°F, about 1 hour. Transfer lamb to a cutting board and let rest 30 minutes. Slice lamb and transfer to a platter. Spoon some braising liquid over and sprinkle with sea salt. Serve with salsa verde and harissa.

title: Creamy Seafood Soup
ingredients: 2 crabs 1/4 kg calamari, cut into rings (small) or shrimp (small) 1/4 kg fish fillet, cut into cubes 1/4 oyster (sea shells) 2 tablespoons flour 2 tablespoons lemon juice 1 onion, chopped 5 fresh coriander leaves salt and pepper 5 celery 5 bay leaves 2 liters water 2 tablespoons oil 3/4 cup whipping cream
directions: Put onions and celery in water till boiling. Add crabs first then sea shells then calamari then leave to boil for 15 minutes. Add flour and lemon juice. On the other hand, in a sauce pan add oil and stir fry with fish and shrimp for 5 minutes then add to soup. Add salt, pepper, coriander and bay leaves. Add whipping cream then leave to boil for 10 minute. Remove celery, coriander and bay leaves before serving. Season with salt and pepper. N.B after crabs are done, you can divide each into two.

title: Caramelized Onions
ingredients: 2 extra-large sweet onions (about 3 pounds) 1 (10 1/2-ounce) can chicken or beef broth, undiluted 1/4 cup butter or margarine
directions: Cut onions in half; cut each half into 1/2-inch-thick slices. Combine all ingredients in a 3 1/2-quart slow cooker. Cook, covered, at HIGH 8 hours or until golden brown and very soft. Store onions in an air-tight container; refrigerate up to 2 weeks, or freeze up to 2 months, if desired.

title: Mediterranean Salad With Broiled Chicken
ingredients: Super Easy and Fast Broiled Chicken Ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless, white-meat organic chicken (breasts, cutlets, or tenders) 3 tablespoons olive oil 3-4 cloves garlic 3-4 lemon slices Sea salt and pepper Salad and Honey Dijon Vinaigrette Ingredients: 2 cups baby spinach 1/2 cup sliced roasted red peppers 1/2 cup sliced marinated artichokes 1/4 cup pitted Kalamata olives 1 pint grape tomatoes Dressing Ingredients 4 tablespoons olive oil 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard 1 teaspoon raw honey
directions: Preheat broiler. Put chicken in the baking sheet (or in a large plastic baggie) and toss with olive oil, garlic, lemon, and some salt and pepper. If you like, cover and set aside for an hour or so to develop flavor (optional). 3. Broil the chicken very quickly, turning once, cooking no more than 3-5 minutes on each side. To check for doneness, use a thin blade knife and cut through the center - should be white or slightly pink. Serve immediately or let cool and refrigerate for later. When ready to make salad, slice chicken into thin strips against the grain. Whisk all vinaigrette ingredients together to make the dressing. Toss spinach, roasted red peppers, artichokes, olives, tomatoes, chicken, and the dressing together and serve!

title: Buss-Up-Shut And Roti Bread
ingredients: 3 cups flour 3 teaspoons baking powder 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 cup water vegetable oil
directions: Sift together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Add the water and mix to form a dough. Knead the dough and let sit for 1/2 hour. Knead again and divide into four balls. Roll out each ball on a floured board to a diameter of about 8 to 10 inches, making each roti as thin as possible. Grease a large skillet or griddle with vegetable oil and heat. Bake each roti for about a minute and a half per side, coating each side with a little oil. Remove carefully and drain on paper towels. The rotis can be left whole for stuffing or torn up for dipping.

title: Peach Jam
ingredients: 2 1/4 c. prepared fruit 2 Tbsp. fresh lemon juice 5 c. sugar 3/4 c. water 1 box powdered fruit pectin
directions: Rinse clean plastic containers and lids with boiling water. Peel and pit peaches; chop very fine. Measure 2 1/4 cups into large bowl. Add lemon juice. Stir sugar into fruit. Let stand 10 minutes; stir occasionally. Mix water and pectin in small saucepan. Bring mixture to boil over high heat, stirring constantly. Continue boiling and stirring 1 minute. Stir pectin mixture into fruit mixture. Stir until sugar dissolves, about 3 minutes. Fill all containers quickly to within 1/2-inch of tops. Wipe off top edges of containers; cover with lids. Let stand at room temperature for 24 hours. Store in refrigerator up to 3 weeks or freeze extra container up to 1 year.

title: Neiman-Marcus Squares
ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix 1 stick margarine, melted 1 egg 1 c. pecans
directions: Mix and press in bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan. Topping recipe follows.

title: Autumn Evening Supper
ingredients: 1 1/2 qt. chopped, cooked potatoes 7 chopped Deluxe pasteurized processed American cheese slices 1/4 c. green onion slices 1/2 c. Kraft golden blend Italian dressing 2 Tbsp. chopped pimento 1 lb. Hillshire Farm smoked sausage, cut into 6 portions 3 Deluxe American slices, cut in half diagonally
directions: Combine potatoes, chopped cheese, onion slices, dressing and pimento. Spoon into an 11 3/4 x 7 1/2-inch baking dish. Top with sausage. Bake at 350° until thoroughly heated. Top with 3 slices of cheese cut in 1/2 diagonally. Continue baking until processed cheese begins to melt. Yields 6 servings.

title: Chunky Pasta Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef 1/2 pound ground pork 2 cans (28 ounces each) diced tomatoes, undrained 1/2 to 1 cup water 1 can (6 ounces) tomato paste 1 cup chopped carrots 1 medium onion, cut into wedges 1 medium sweet red pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces 2 tablespoons sugar 2 teaspoons minced garlic 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon dried basil 1 teaspoon dried oregano 1 teaspoon pepper Hot cooked bow tie pasta
directions: In a large skillet, cook beef and pork over medium heat until no longer pink; drain. Transfer to a 3-qt. slow cooker. Stir in the tomatoes, water, tomato paste, vegetables, sugar, garlic and seasonings. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or until vegetables are tender. Serve with pasta.

title: Spicy Seattle Tuna Rolls
ingredients: 4 Green Thai chiles, stemmed, coarsely chopped 1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon grated peeled fresh ginger 1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds 1 garlic clove, coarsely chopped 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt plus more for seasoning 1/4 cup sunflower or vegetable oil 2 teaspoons toasted sesame oil 1 teaspoon distilled white vinegar 1 pound sashimi-grade yellowfin tuna fillets, cut into 1/8" cubes 4 toasted dried nori sheets, halved lengthwise 1 1/2 cups (about) cooked short-grain rice, cooled Assorted fillings, such as sliced scallions, English hothouse or Persian cucumbers, cilantro leaves, and chive blossoms **Ingredient info:**Look for Thai chiles, nori, and chive blossoms at better supermarkets and at Asian markets.
directions: Puree chiles, ginger, sesame seeds, garlic, and 1/2 teaspoon salt in a mini-processor until paste forms. Transfer to a medium bowl. Stir in both oils and vinegar. Season dressing with salt. Add tuna; gently toss just to coat. Place nori sheets on a work surface with short side facing you. Spread about 2 rounded tablespoons rice evenly on bottom third of each sheet. Divide tuna mixture among rolls, spooning over rice. Top with fillings. Roll into cones or log shapes, using a few grains of cooked rice as "glue" to seal.

title: Indulgent Sticky Toffee Pudding
ingredients: FOR THE CAKE: 2 ounces, weight Butter 5-2/3 ounces, weight Brown Sugar 4-5/8 ounces, weight Golden Syrup 2 Eggs 1 cup, 6 tablespoons, 7/8 teaspoons, 1-1/4 pinches Boiling Water 7-7/8 ounces, weight Dates (stones Removed) 1 Tablespoon Bicarbonate Of Soda 7 ounces, weight Self-Rising Flour FOR THE SAUCE: 2-7/8 ounces, weight Butter 5 ounces, weight Brown Sugar 10 tablespoons, 7 pinches Cream 2 Tablespoons Salt 2-1/8 ounces, weight Milk Chocolate
directions: Preheat oven to 190 Celsius (375F). 1. Cream the 55 grams butter and 160 grams brown sugar with a mixer. 2. Add the golden syrup and blend well. 3. Add eggs one at a time (mix well after each addition). Set aside. 4. In the blender: Pour the hot water over the dates and let it buzz to blend the two. 5. Add the bicarbonate of soda to the date and water mix and blend to combine. 6. Fold the flour and the date mix into the egg/sugar mix (or mix together with mixer on very low speed until combined - don't over beat). 7. Pour the batter into a baking tin or individual ramekins (don't pour in too much - there's a lot of raising agent in this dish) and bake for 20 (ramekins)/25 minutes (large baking tin). You can tell it is done if you insert a knife into it and there is a bit of resistance - but keep in mind it needs to still be gooey. 8. Let it cool down a little on a rack. You can serve it fresh out of the oven or heat it up in the microwave when you are ready. Needs to be served warm but not boiling hot. Serve with a salty caramel sauce. (I sometimes make a double portion of this sauce because people guzzle this one up!) For the sauce: Melt the 80 grams butter and 140 grams brown sugar in a saucepan on medium heat. Take the pan off the heat and add the other ingredients (cream, salt, and chocolate) and stir until melted. It's important to keep stirring the sauce to get a nice soft texture. Serve hot sauce drizzled over the pudding.

title: Spinach, Red Lentil, And Bean Curry
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils 1/4 cup tomato puree 1/2 (8 ounce) container plain yogurt 1 teaspoon garam masala 1/2 teaspoon ground dried turmeric 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon ancho chile powder 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 onion, chopped 2 cloves garlic, chopped 1 (1 inch) piece fresh ginger root, grated 4 cups loosely packed fresh spinach, coarsely chopped 2 tomatoes, chopped 4 sprigs fresh cilantro, chopped 1 (15.5 ounce) can mixed beans, rinsed and drained
directions: Rinse lentils and place in a saucepan with enough water to cover. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to low, cover pot, and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes. Drain. In a bowl, stir together tomato puree and yogurt. Season with garam masala, turmeric, cumin, and chile powder. Stir until creamy. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Stir in onion, garlic, and ginger; cook until onion begins to brown. Stir in spinach; cook until dark green and wilted. Gradually stir in yogurt mixture. Then mix in tomatoes and cilantro. Stir lentils and mixed beans into mixture until well combined. Heat through, about 5 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Pie
ingredients: 1 (6 oz.) pkg. thin spaghetti 2 Tbsp. margarine 1/3 c. grated Parmesan 2 beaten eggs 1 lb. ground beef 1/2 c. chopped onion 1/4 c. chopped green pepper 1 (8 oz.) can tomato sauce 1 (6 oz.) can tomato paste 1 tsp. oregano 1 c. cottage cheese 1 (2 oz.) pkg. grated Mozzarella
directions: Cook spaghetti and drain. Add margarine, cheese and beaten eggs. Mix and form into crust in 10-inch pie pan.
